reviews.author: Marcus R.
reviews.text: Hands down the cleanest skin fade in town. I've tried multiple shops and nobody blends with this level of precision. The atmosphere is top notch and you walk out feeling like a million bucks.

reviews.author: Andre L.
reviews.text: The hot towel straight razor beard treatment is pure luxury. Clean lines, zero irritation, and great attention to detail. True masters who take pride in their craft.

reviews.author: David T.
reviews.text: Needed a tight haircut on short notice and booked online easily. Convenient location, easy parking, and top-tier service from start to finish.

reviews.author: Jason T.
reviews.text: Brought my son in for a fade and got my beard lined up. Patient, professional, and razor work was on point. Great vibe in the lounge, definitely our go-to spot!

faq.question: Do I need an appointment or do you accept walk-ins?
faq.answer: Walk-ins are always welcome! However, to avoid waiting during peak hours, we recommend booking your chair online in advance.

faq.question: How do I book an appointment?
faq.answer: You can book directly 24/7 through our Booksy booking page with instant confirmation and real-time barber availability.

faq.question: Where is the barbershop located and is there parking?
faq.answer: We are conveniently located at 123 Main Street, Suite 100 in Apex Plaza near Main St & 1st Ave. Plenty of free parking is available in the plaza lot.

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept Cash, Apple Pay, Google Pay, major Credit/Debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX), and contactless payments.

faq.question: What is your cancellation or late arrival policy?
faq.answer: We appreciate at least 2 hours advance notice for cancellations. If you are running more than 10 minutes late, please give us a call at (555) 000-0000 so we can adjust your chair time.
